label: Rational authorship and epistemic ends in contingent creation
summary: Proposed unreviewed philosophical checkpoint at main 8083301a037428574d0e46b1064d8f6d858da377. Reuses #742 base-fixed net selection, #545/#555 necessitation and reason-closure boundaries, #1875 necessary bearer/contingent output and omission controls, #1380 knowledge discrimination, #737 and #1410 veracity boundaries. Distinguishes productive actual explanation, partial contrastive reasons and exhaustive determining reasons at the same whole-order explanandum. Practical authorship candidate: apprehended end, adoption for an actual reason, and intention-directed production distinguish purposive realization from post-hoc labeling and controlled lottery policy without necessarily explaining the exact endorsement contrast. Counterexample to treating the personal label as sufficient: an uncontrolled random selector within a reason-constrained policy. The same productive standard credits an impersonal producer; its modal/causal stability is compatible with reliable evidence. Normative candidate: deliberate systematic frustration of a conferred truth-directed epistemic capacity, without overriding justification, is contrary to faithfully realizing that specific end. Requires domain, normal use, genuine cognition and goodness; assertion truthfulness is not a trace-reliability theorem. No modal collapse or skepticism inferred from mere source contingency, and no actual divine application established. C2 concerns absence of n, not absence of distinct created effects. Note: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#rational-authorship-versus-brute-selection-2026-11-23-proposed-unreviewed. No new theorem, statement, definition, sourced claim, or support edge. Existing full-synthesis underdetermination retained; author-side semantic sweep only. Continuation (same date, proposed): docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#can-direct-intentional-production-be-extrinsic-without-becoming-brute-2026-11-23-proposed-unreviewed. Read ST I q.19 a.5 and q.45 a.3/q.13 a.7 alongside q.14 a.8–9,11 and the prior #462 O'Connor/Huneeus comparison. Distinguish one-act rational order of willed means and ends from the causing of a separate act of willing. Test coarse intention versus content-specific production and merely permitted consequences. Rejected shortcut: success-defined productive relation entails the effect trivially, which does not demonstrate nontrivial efficacy of a specific intention. Compare A: a particular agent-directed productive transaction, not a separately caused executive state; B: specific content-adoption with independently intelligible intentional object and an explanatory role prior to realization, not an outcome-copying label. A can conditionally cover concrete existential dependence without settling the fact-level transaction's obtaining; B needs an account of contingent nonintrinsic adoption consistent with strict simplicity. The strong intrinsic difference principle is an additional premise, not entailed by the weak difference of the whole transaction or by absence of passive change. Productive self-knowledge needs actual direction/reference, not mere possibility knowledge or causal scope. Conditional no-mediator regress applies only to recursively demanded separate voluntary mediators; no proof of metaphysical possibility or full agency. The earlier underdetermination judgment remains; no new source binding or formal edge. Further continuation §§11–14: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#exemplar-as-practical-measure-can-specificity-belong-to-the-exercise-2026-11-23-proposed-unreviewed. ST I q.15 a.1–3 and q.14 a.8–9,15–16 give a positive distinction between the one cognitive principle and multiple understood exemplars, and between possible content and actually practical knowledge. SEP Action §4/Intention (secondary orientation) motivates practical measure rather than a separately caused executive event. Distinguish fixed intelligible content from variable operative role; test an intended equilateral triangle, lottery-selected triangle and misexecuted scalene intention with identical actual result. This is not a same-intrinsic-state model. A determinate specification has fulfillment conditions independently of the actual product; a world-label or successful output cannot establish its actual normative role. A nonintrinsically individuated productive exercise for a recognized exemplar is a positive hypothesis, not an implication of q.15. Exact disputed intrinsic-role supervenience versus a genuine same-intrinsic-actuality alternative pair with varying operative content. Same-source application to #1459 recipient-directed existence-willing and #1380 practical self-knowledge remains conditional. No new formal result or attributed claim; prior underdetermination retained. Further continuation §§15–18: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#active-power-immanent-operation-and-the-essential-object-of-an-act-2026-11-23-proposed-unreviewed. Aristotle Physics III.3 locates the shared motion in the movable (reuse existing typed readings); this does not establish no intrinsic changes in the mover. Aquinas De potentia q.1 a.1, q.3 a.15 fourth argument/ad 14–20, q.7 a.10 and ST I q.25/q.45 distinguish active principle from passive actualization, explicitly reject a transitive intermediary divine operation, and distinguish necessary immanent actuality from contingent effects. Grant–Spencer (2015), pp.12–15,40–42,53–56, distinguishes divine-act identity from essentiality of its secondary object. Reuse #555: identity/BeingCarriesAct plus secondary-object essentiality and strict content-specific efficacy would exclude an actual distinct effect's contingency; locating the effect in the patient does not by itself escape. Positive restricted-essentiality rationale: nonreceptive cognition and finite manifestations do not exhaust the divine primary good; no inference from nonexhaustion to multiple metaphysically possible choices without policy/possibility premises. Thin productive dependence plus exemplar conformity does not distinguish a coarse or blind policy from operative D-specific willing. A genuine directed exercise could be relationally individuated without a distinct intrinsic executive state, but its actual intentional-role and fact-level adequacy bridges are OPEN. Conditional textual preference for one immanent principle over a transitive intermediary, continued suspension about joint metaphysical applicability. Reuse #1731 IntentionalExemplarExtension, #1459 and #1380 without importing their open bridges. No new source claim or formal result.
blocker: OPEN: constitutive intentional reference and actual productive direction at the same simple necessary source without a world-label selector or contingent intrinsic modifier; scope of determining closure at contingent endorsement; nonvacuous normative limits on creative choices and absence of overriding reasons for systematic misleading evidence; actual evidence provenance and agent access. Need independent final semantic challenge, canonical related/dossier/novelty and offline validation, computed frontier-diff. No premise discharge claimed. Narrowed test: can source-level directed production under a contrast-discriminating description be genuine without an independently existing intrinsic executive selection-state? Determine whether the content-adoption distinction is explanatorily substantive, compatible with the q.45 creature-side relation reading, and adequate for efficacy and #1380's particular knowledge; otherwise assess which intrinsic simplicity commitment must be weakened. Scope note §§6–10; final independent challenge pending. Next: compare rival ontologies of active-power exercise and intentional object as formally constitutive measure, rather than more extensional tables. Test whether an actually D-directed exercise is a distinct intrinsic actuality, a nonintrinsic productive transaction, or merely an output description; preserve #1459 recipient scope, #555 rigid-token efficacy and #1380 factivity/reference. Independent review of §§11–14 and canonical checks pending. Next discriminator: restricted secondary-object essentiality itself; whether the particular practical term is essential to a numerically identical intrinsic operation, or a genuine, non-accidental directed exercise. Test its role and real possibility without post-hoc output labels, with horizontal support from actual cognition and active-power/essence routes. Independent challenge of §§15–18 and current-head CI remain required.
